text:
nora: hi team, new hire here. trying to wrap up obs access for the private-embed service. issues: 1) datadog dashboards visible but creating monitors returns 403, 2) grafana alert button is disabled on the dashboard (no tooltip), 3) i can't find the Sentry DSN in our vault. who should i ping for each?

devex-bot: Welcome @nora! Typical flow: join eng-observability group, request folder Editor+Alerting in Grafana, open infra ticket for Sentry project provisioning. Use template obs-onboard: https://redwood.internal/infra/new?template=obs-onboard :robot_face:

pat: hey @nora 03 on Datadog usually equals missing app key or insufficient application key perms (monitors_write). paste the datadog dashboard url and i can check. if urgent i can spin up a test monitor under my app key.

eli: regarding Grafana, if the alert button has no tooltip that often means the instance-level alerting plugin is disabled for private clusters. if you can share the dashboard UID (Dashboards -> Share -> Link), i'll check the folder settings and feature flags. if it's permissions i can add Editor+Alerting.

nora: datadog link: https://datadog.redwood.internal/dash/qwe-3901/private-embed?from_ts=1625000000000&to_ts=1625003600000

pat: saw it 1 you only have dashboards_read. i can create a short-lived monitor for testing: example curl (replace keys):
```
curl -s -X POST "https://api.datadoghq.com/api/v1/monitor"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -H "DD-API-KEY: $DD_API_KEY"
  -H "DD-APPLICATION-KEY: $DD_APP_KEY"
  -d '{"name":"test: private-embed latency","type":"metric alert","query":"avg(last_1m):avg:private.embed.latency{env:prod} > 800","message":"@pagerduty test","tags":["team:private-embed"]}'
```
will create and fire a test if you want.

eli: dashboard UID is `uvT7-mno`. i checked folder: alerting plugin is enabled, but the folder has a special "read-only" flag for customer-managed dashboards. i can flip that flag or add you as Editor+Alerting. which do you prefer?

nora: add me as Editor+Alerting pls, i'll do the alert config. also i opened infra ticket OBS-3999 for Sentry with slug `private-embed-nora` and linked the service repo. do infra provide server and public DSNs?

infra-bot: OBS-3999 acknowledged. infra will provision server DSN and evaluate public DSN policy based on envs. include env list (prod/staging) in the ticket to speed it up. ETA ~48 hrs unless you add 'expedite'.

pat: created the test monitor and tagged team:private-embed. it fired and routed to #private-embed-alerts. confirm you saw the ping, @nora.

nora: saw it, thanks! eli  once you add Editor role can you also help with a grafana panel embed for our internal runbook? prefer a signed iframe if possible.

eli: yep. for Confluence we issue short-lived signed embeds (1h). share the panel link + confluence page id and i'll generate the token. note: if this will be customer-facing we prefer a static snapshot export.

devex-bot: tip: use infra ticket template obs-onboard to pre-populate required fields (slug, repo, envs) to speed Sentry provisioning. docs: https://redwood.internal/obs/onboard

nora: filing the env list now. thanks everyone for the quick help 60a
